provenance.source: DX-RAG original AI-assisted fictional NovaTech Chinese policy corpus; evidence/corpus-provenance.md and evidence/snapshot.json.
provenance.distribution_basis: Original project material; fictional company, no real employee data; source provenance retained.
provenance.annotation_method: LLM candidate suggestions followed by Human project owner wording/category/answerability, all 1520 grades, full coverage, facts/splits, 20 dedup groups and SC01/SC02 decisions. Single reviewer; no inter-annotator agreement claim. Frozen promotion is still pending.
provenance.git_context: See manifest.json git_context and tool hashes; files are working-tree artifacts, not claimed present in HEAD. V1 reference tag v1.0.0.
provenance.limitations: Single fictional organization; AI-assisted original policy corpus, not real employee queries or production prevalence. | Only four policy domains and 38 chunks; not a large-corpus, cross-company or real-world generalization benchmark. | Per-category cells contain 3–5 answerable questions; category weights differ across Dev and Test; avoid treating their aggregates as directly comparable quality changes. | Known Pilot exposure; seven positive chunks and two supporting rules cross splits; Test is not blind or source-independent. Do not tune on Test. | Eight unanswerables all have one grade-1 policy neighbor and no grade>=2; limited to near-policy missing-information cases, not full negative-query coverage. | Unanswerables are excluded from main answerable Recall/MRR/nDCG; retained separately, not evidence of generation refusal quality. | No benchmark result exists; small scale is accepted only if Human decides; formal version approval remains separate. | No live model/index/store readiness check; UUIDs tied to original snapshot. Reingestion needs identity reconciliation/review. V1 metadata/page provenance and tied-score repeatability limitations remain; no retrieval outputs or measured metrics in this package.
provenance.ingestion_config: {"MAX_CHUNK_SIZE": 800, "CHUNK_OVERLAP": 120, "DEFAULT_TOP_K": 5, "MIN_RELEVANCE_SCORE": 0.3, "MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_MB": 50, "EMBED_MODEL": "models/bge-small-zh-v1.5", "UPLOAD_DIR": "uploads", "CHROMA_PERSIST_DIR": "chroma_db"}; historical V1 ingestion evidence, not a new ingestion. Full configuration in evidence/snapshot.json.
provenance.model_version: {"class": "SentenceTransformer", "dimension": 512, "max_seq_length": 512}; historical models/bge-small-zh-v1.5 with model_files_sha256 retained in evidence/snapshot.json; current model and vectors not verified.
